QuestInfo.name: The Price of Information
QuestInfo.0: Does #p406# of #m10003000# actually know anything about the whereabouts of that doctor, Niora?
QuestInfo.1: #b#p406##k of #m10003000# said she couldn't just hand over information for free, but promised to tell me what she knew if I took care of a job request that had just come in. Let's gather #b#t4000024#s#k for her.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I brought #p406# what she'd asked for. Now it's time to hear what she knows.

0.0: I'd heard the rumors about a ghost over at #m10003004# too. But I'm honestly surprised it turned out to be true. A ghost... just the thought of it gives me chills, but waiting around for someone named Niora like that, it's kinda sad if you ask me.
0.1: That said, I'm not handing out information for free. That's just how it works around here. As it happens, I've got a request that just came in — take care of that for me, and I'll tell you what I know. Deal?

yes.0: Good. What I need is #b10 #t4000024#s#k. Finding a way to get your hands on it is part of the job, so I'm counting on you!

no.0: Didn't expect you to turn me down. Guess that means I can't give you any information either, then.

1.0: Didn't expect you back so soon. Let's see... yep, 10 #t4000024#s, no doubt about it. Have to hand it to you, #h0#, you always get the job done.

item.0: Bring me #b10 #t4000024#s#k, and I'll tell you what I know about that doctor, Niora.
